scope: Held-grasp diversity and privileged-teacher actor initialization for standard79 RJ45 insertion

physics_pilot.geometry_constraint: 80 um initial x/y jitter is below the configured 150 um nominal locator side/front gaps; this is a static configuration check, not a claim of dynamic collision-free operation

separation.acceptance: Every accepted pair must exceed at least one object-to-EE threshold; joint posture alone cannot qualify a grasp

physics_pilot.production_gate: At least three of the four fixed-seed runs must have verified held states with pairwise object-to-EE grasp separation
physics_pilot.failure_action: Keep the pilot evidence; do not expand object jitter into locator walls or lower the separation threshold. Audit tangential local grasp targets and preregister a new physical generation method before production.

production_bank.selection: First physically valid and geometrically separated candidates in each fixed seed list, without policy-performance selection; preserve every rejection reason
production_bank.final_scope: Physical generation and manifest metadata only; no final-policy evaluation or final demonstrations during development
production_bank.generalization_claim_limit: Small-bank held-state robustness within one simulated robot, connector geometry, and contact model
production_bank.build_evidence_sidecar: Pin candidate-plan/protocol SHA, thresholds, ordered candidates and every rejection; bank metadata and policy-selection inputs cannot replace this record

teacher_data.policy_observation: standard79; no privileged teacher ground truth in student input
teacher_data.teacher_target: G_true times F_actual times inverse(F_hat), at committed insertion depth
teacher_data.action: Existing bounded right-only 6D tip-target action; left action remains zero
teacher_data.recording: All fixed per-environment episode quotas, including failures and invalid warmup rows; both global action-input time and actual observation time retained
teacher_data.dataset_gate: Verified mixed-bank physical resets, completed current-source nominal evidence, zero invalid terminal episodes, finite records, and successful valid demonstrations for every train/dev grasp

behavior_cloning.architecture: 79 -> 256 ELU -> 256 ELU -> 128 ELU -> 6; no added observation normalization
behavior_cloning.epoch_selection: Lowest dev MSE among completed epochs 1..40; earliest epoch on an exact tie
behavior_cloning.diagnostic: Fixed-seed cross-episode nearest-neighbor label variation, excluded from model selection
behavior_cloning.extra_compute_accounting: Report teacher simulation transitions, BC gradient updates/sample visits/time separately from PPO transitions

comparison.paired_conditions: Same dev grasp IDs, per-environment quotas, calibration-bias seed and episode index
comparison.promotion_gate: BC-then-PPO mean dev successes must exceed both baseline and PPO-only mean by at least 6/64, with zero invalid episodes and zero forbidden-contact load in all paired runs
comparison.failure_action: Keep final seed sealed and report the failed promotion; investigate observed limits without changing the success tolerance

profile_selection.rule: Use the eligible F/N/R profile selected by the already fixed 4B scale protocol; if none is eligible, use N for both PPO-only and BC-then-PPO. Freeze this choice before teacher data collection and every 4C policy run.

identical_except_actor_initialization: PPO runner configuration excluding the same paired seed override
training configuration including reward and observation
source commit and source file hashes
train bank manifest and ordered train grasp IDs
evaluation bank and per-environment episode quotas
fairness_contract.BC_then_PPO_actor_initialization: verified actor-only artifact; preserve critic, policy noise, optimizer, and RNG state
fairness_contract.launch_gate: Before launching any teacher data or policy run, freeze exact derived PPO/training path and SHA, source/config/asset SHA map, bank manifest SHA, dataset SHA, BC recipe/artifact SHA, commands, paired seed mapping, and all evaluation quotas in a create-new input manifest; fail closed on every later mutation
fairness_contract.evaluation_pairing: For each seed and declared checkpoint, compare all attempts on the same dev IDs/bias cases. Compare 200-update results for promotion; 20/96 are diagnostic only.
